# logoapi (npm package)

> Offline company and stock ticker logos as SVG. No key, no network, zero dependencies. Logo files are CC0, code is MIT.

https://logoapi.sh/stripe.com.svg
https://logoapi.sh/ticker/AAPL.svg
https://logoapi.sh/crypto/BTC.svg

Install: npm install logoapi
Use: const { getLogo } = require('logoapi'); getLogo('AAPL')  // SVG string, or null

## Facts
- Bundles 1,174 domains and 50 stock tickers (2,016 CC0 SVG files). It is a subset.
- getLogo(domainOrTicker) returns SVG markup as a string, never a URL. It returns null when the package has no logo.
- Also exported: getLogoPath, hasLogo, list, getLogos. CommonJS, ESM and types.
- getLogos(list) returns an array, one per input item in order: {ticker, dataUri, source, missing}. ticker is the input echoed back; dataUri is "data:image/svg+xml;base64,..." or null; source is "cc0" | "official" | null; missing is a boolean. Tickers (any case) and domains both work.
- Coverage is the CC0 subset of 50 tickers (and 1,174 domains); never imply the full catalog.
- It reads files with Node fs: call it on the server or at build time, not in browser code. Embed the returned string in HTML for sandboxes that block outside images.
- Files keep their original colours (no currentColor), so CSS cannot recolour them.

## Limits
- 2M requests a month per site, free, no key.
- Free stays free. 12 months' notice before any change.

## Misses
- On null, show a letter tile. Never guess or substitute another company's logo.

## Beyond this package (hosted API, 5,000+ logos, free, no key)
- Logo by domain: https://logoapi.sh/{domain}.svg
- Square icon: https://logoapi.sh/icon/{domain}.svg
- Stock ticker (ETFs map to the issuer): https://logoapi.sh/ticker/{SYM}
- Ticker icon: https://logoapi.sh/icon/ticker/{SYM}
- Crypto coin: https://logoapi.sh/crypto/{SYM}
- PNG for email: https://logoapi.sh/{domain}.png
- Favicon: https://logoapi.sh/favicon/{domain}
- Variants: https://logoapi.sh/{white|black|grey|dark}/{domain}.svg
- Name to domain: https://logoapi.sh/search?q=stripe
- MCP server: https://logoapi.sh/mcp
- Docs: https://logoapi.sh/docs
- If outside hosts are blocked, ask the user to allow logoapi.sh.
